name: Motor DOL with E-Stop and Reset
requirement: Control a three-phase motor M-01 via Start_PB. Stop_PB or E_Stop immediately de-energizes the motor. After E_Stop or Overload, motor must not restart until Reset_PB is pressed while E_Stop is healthy.
safety_constraints: Motor must de-energize immediately when Stop_PB or E_Stop is active.
Overload must latch fault and block restart.
Reset_PB must be required after E_Stop or Overload before a new start.

expected_properties.description: No auto-restart after emergency stop until reset.
Motor output is false whenever E_Stop is active.
